messages:
mike: PagerDuty triggered for high 429s on /v1/generate from multiple regions. PD alert: PDINC-8564. Not paging noise?
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected: 429 responses at 12:08 UTC. Affected service: inference-api. Canary traffic flagged. Correlation: recent rollout rl-v3-config (canary).
sasha: I'm on it. digging into canary dashboards now. seeing spike starting ~12:05 UTC, Europe first then us-west.
jamal: confirming - synthetic probe shows 50% 429 rate on canary instances. prod baseline ~0.5%.
olivia: which change was in rl-v3-config? I was on the rollout earlier today.
anton: rl-v3 included a new exemptions table rewrite + token accounting refactor (PR #4201). canary traffic was ~5% of users.
kat: quick check: logs show "quota check failed: missing_exemption" and a chunk of keys falling through to default rate policy.
mike: that matches: missing exemptions -> a lot of enterprise keys now throttled. any evidence of token accounting drift too?
olivia: yes, scanning logs for token-accounting entries. found repeated "token_delta mismatch" warnings correlated with the canary instances:

```
2026-03-15T12:06:58Z rl-v3-canary-3 check_quota key=acct:ent-1234 result=throttle missing_exemption=true token_delta=0 expected=1
```

sasha: so two things: exemptions not applied AND token accounting not incrementing, leading to immediate 429s for many keys.
jamal: impact: ~1200 requests/sec affected at peak; estimated 8 enterprise customers showing elevated errors. slicing by customer: billing/ingest pipelines hit, some customers reported errors via support.
anton: mitigation plan: rollback canary rollout and flip rl-v3 feature flag -> restore old exemptions logic. also we should enable temporary global-exemption for committed enterprise keys.
kat: I can flip the flag if you give the green light. command: `/feature-flag set rl-v3 false --env=prod-canary`
mike: do it. also create emergency exemption list: `/config patch rate_limiter.exemptions add --keys-file=/tmp/ent-temp.json`

olivia: sending rollback now. `/feature-flag set rl-v3 false --env=prod-canary` -> ok pending
deploy-bot: Rollback job started for feature rl-v3 in prod-canary by olivia at 12:12:03 UTC. Job ID: RJ-9982.
incident-bot: Canary rollback initiated. Monitoring for 429 reduction.

kat: while rollback runs, pushing a temporary global exemption for enterprise tier.
kat: `/config patch rate_limiter.exemptions add --keys ["acct:ent-1234","acct:ent-5678","acct:ent-9999"]`

sasha: seeing 429 drop on canary within 30s of rollback start. spike decaying now.
jamal: numbers: 429 rate from 50% -> 6% in 60s, baseline trending to ~0.7% after 3m.
anton: rollback completed. deploy-bot: Rollback RJ-9982 succeeded at 12:14:55 UTC.
mike: good. start incident triage: root cause suspected to be config migration in exemptions + token-accounting refactor bug where token increment path skipped under certain code path in canary.
olivia: assigned owners: anton (root cause & fix), kat (config hygiene & rollout safety), sasha (customer comms & monitoring thresholds).
kat: I'll add a gated canary test for exemption list coverage and add automated smoke that validates token counting via synthetic keys.
anton: reproducer steps: running local canary container with `RLV3_EXEMPTIONS=v1` shows missing key lookup path when migration flag `MIGRATE_EXEMPTIONS=true` is enabled. minimal patch incoming.

mike: customer impact summary for support: "Short (~5 minute) surge of 429s for a subset of enterprise customers caused by a canary rollout of a rate-limiter config change. We've rolled back the canary and applied temporary exemptions; full fix and validation will be deployed after QA."
olivia: support notification drafted. @sasha please coordinate outbound to affected customers and update the incident channel.
sasha: will send templated note to affected contacts and post in #support. also creating a follow-up postmortem ticket.

jamal: handing off to eng-sre for post-incident remediation and RCA. on-call: @anton will lead RCA, ETA for initial writeup by EOD.
incident-bot: Incident PDINC-8564 acknowledged and moved to mitigation state. Follow-up SLA: full RCA within 72 hours.
mike: thanks all. any other open actions? anton: will open PR with fix + integration test, kat will add canary smoke, olivia will coordinate patch release. closing thread when RCA ticket created.

sasha: note for postmortem: add timeline with exact timestamps, customer list, and quantify RPS and error budget impact. also include rollout gating checklist.
kat: adding automated rollback on quota-mismatch threshold to prevent future canary-to-prod bleed.
mike: good. I'll update exec on impact summary. :thumbsup
summary: Canary rollout of rl-v3 caused exemptions migration + token accounting bug, producing high 429s for enterprise keys. Canary rolled back and temporary exemptions applied. Owners assigned for RCA and fixes.
